subject.title: fix: prevent A2A target from reverse-calling sessions_send to requester (#39476)

question: Should an A2A target retain `sessions_send` for independent forwarding to other agents while being prevented only from sending back to the requester?
rationale: The current patch deliberately removes the entire tool for routed target turns; preserving existing A2A fanout versus adopting a no-send-during-A2A policy is a compatibility and product-contract choice.

options.title: Block requester-only sends
options.body: Carry the requester destination into the send guard, reject only reverse sends to that requester, and preserve target-to-third-agent A2A sends.

options.title: Adopt no-send A2A targets
options.body: Accept that every routed target turn loses `sessions_send`, document the behavioral restriction, and add compatibility proof for affected orchestration workflows.

options.title: Pause for A2A contract design
options.body: Pause this branch if the repository needs a first-class one-way or typed handoff contract rather than an implicit tool-availability rule.

recommendation.title: Block requester-only sends
recommendation.body: Carry the requester destination into the send guard, reject only reverse sends to that requester, and preserve target-to-third-agent A2A sends.

likelyOwner.reason: Their feature-history work spans the session-send, provenance, and agent-tool seams that define this A2A contract.
